Question Choices: Select all shapes that are parallelograms: ~~A | B | C | D | E | F~~
Hints: Check opposite parallel sides, right angles and equal side lengths; a shape may belong to several families.
Solution: B (square),C (rectangle)andE (slanted parallelogram) each have two opposite parallel pairs. A is a triangle; D has nonparallel opposite sides; F has only one parallel pair. Select B,C,E.

Question Choices: Select all shapes that are quadrilaterals: ~~A | B | C | D | E | F~~
Hints: Follow the entire boundary and count four straight sides, including any inward corner.
Solution: Every pictured outline has four straight sides. A is a square, B a rhombus,C a rectangle,D a trapezoid,E a parallelogram,F a concave quadrilateral. The inward corner inF does not change its four-side count.

Question Choices: Select the most specific shape name that has all these properties- 1) all four angles are right angles 2) all four sides are the same length 3)both pairs of opposite sides are parallel: ~~Square | Rectangle | Rhombus | Trapeziod | Pentagon~~
Hints: Four equal sides make a rhombus; four right angles make a rectangle; both conditions make a square.
Solution: Four equal sides and four right angles give the most specific name square. A square is also a rectangle, rhombus and parallelogram, but those broader names do not require both conditions.

Question Choices: Select the most specific shape name. This quadrilateral has two pairs of parallel sides. All four sides are the same length, but none of the angles are right angles. What is the name for this shape?: ~~Dart | Trapezoid | Isosceles-trapezoid | Parallelogram | Kite | Rhombus | Rectangle | Square~~
Hints: Four equal sides make a rhombus; four right angles make a rectangle; both conditions make a square.
Solution: All four sides match, making a rhombus. With no right angles it cannot be a rectangle or square. A parallelogram alone need not have equal sides.

Question Choices: Select. A quadrilateral has exactly one pair of parallel sides and no right angles. What is the best name for this shape?: ~~Square | Rectangle | Trapezoid | Parallelogram~~
Hints: Exactly one parallel pair identifies a trapezoid under either common definition.
Solution: Exactly one parallel pair gives a trapezoid. Squares, rectangles and parallelograms have two pairs. The absence of right angles is consistent with a trapezoid.

Question Choices: Fill: A quadrilateral with four right angles and adjacent sides that are not equal in length is called a ________. (square or rectangle or rhombus)
Hints: Check opposite parallel sides, right angles and equal side lengths; a shape may belong to several families.
Solution: Four right angles give a rectangle. Unequal adjacent sides exclude a square and rhombus.

Question Choices: Fill: A four-sided parallelogram with all sides equal and all angles right angles is called a ________. (rhombus or square or trapezoid)
Hints: Four equal sides make a rhombus; four right angles make a rectangle; both conditions make a square.
Solution: Four equal sides and four right angles give the most specific name square. A square is also a rectangle, rhombus and parallelogram, but those broader names do not require both conditions.

Question Choices: Select. Which shape must have BOTH pairs of opposite sides parallel and ALL four sides the same length?: ~~Rectangle | Rhombus | Trapezoid~~
Hints: Check opposite parallel sides, right angles and equal side lengths; a shape may belong to several families.
Solution: Every rhombus has four equal sides and two parallel opposite pairs. A rectangle need not have four equal sides, and a trapezoid need not have two parallel pairs.

Question Choices: True or False: Every square is also a rectangle, but not every rectangle is a square.
Hints: Check opposite parallel sides, right angles and equal side lengths; a shape may belong to several families.
Solution: A square has four right angles, so it meets the rectangle definition. A rectangle such as 3 cm by 5 cm has unequal adjacent sides and is not a square. Therefore the statement is true.

Question Choices: Select. A quadrilateral is drawn so that both pairs of opposite sides are parallel, but none of its angles are right angles. What is the BEST name for this shape?: ~~Square | Rectangle | Rhombus | Parallelogram~~
Hints: Check opposite parallel sides, right angles and equal side lengths; a shape may belong to several families.
Solution: Two opposite parallel pairs guarantee a parallelogram. No right angles exclude rectangles and squares. Equal side lengths are not given, so rhombus is not guaranteed.
